note: CLEFS ONLY. Every cell here is the first measure of a staff, so each prints a clef at its left edge. Box the clef glyph and nothing else. Pick the slot by WHICH CLEF IS DRAWN, not which line it sits on — clefC covers alto/tenor/soprano and the line is measured downstream by clef_geometry. The little 8 under a treble clef is its own class. If a cell shows no clef, Tab past it; that still records the sweep. These cells are gathered from several batches into one place and a merge script writes the boxes back home.
